texts.coverage_definition: Licence coverage means the countries where generic versions of the PrEP products could be made available.
texts.licence_types: Both MPP licences and bilateral licences are voluntary licences. MPP licences are concluded through the Medicines Patent Pool, while bilateral licences are signed directly between the originator and generic manufacturers.
texts.data_sources: Licence coverage: derived from the licence documents. HIV burden (new HIV acquisitions and incidence): UNAIDS estimates for 2025, all ages. Countries for which UNAIDS publishes no estimate are not counted in the share of new HIV acquisitions. Income groups: World Bank income classification (current).
texts.currency_note: Territory lists and patent status change over time. Check MedsPaL and LAPaL for the current position before relying on this for a decision.
texts.ami_disclaimer: The publicly available alimatravir (AMI) licence does not include Appendix 3, which lists the patents. Without that list, assessing indirect coverage (countries outside the licence territory where generics could still be supplied) is challenging, so the AMI map shows the licence territory only.
